title: PowerPoint & Charts
description: New tools: text-based PowerPoint (.pptx) generation with design templates and slide previews, plus interactive stats charts (bar/line/area/pie) with hover and PNG export.

title: More Free Tools + Command Palette
description: Added currency conversion and an English dictionary. Type ':' in the chat box to browse tools and insert example prompts.

title: Static Sites & Frontend Skill
description: Website generation is now static-only (HTML/CSS/JS, no backend) and follows a built-in frontend design guide. Image generation is not supported; the assistant lists what it can do instead.

title: Models & UX Polish
description: Refreshed model lineup (Mistral default, Claude Haiku available), added a Stop button, cursor pointers on clickable items, and removed the Integrations panel.

title: Reliability Fixes
description: Fixed Netlify sites serving raw HTML, stopped generated files leaking as blob text, and surfaced clearer streaming errors.

title: UI Simplification
description: Moved settings and help forms from sidebar to account menu for a cleaner interface.

title: Dropdawn Aesthetic
description: Introduced the signature Dropdawn theme and animated example prompts.

title: Public Beta & Auth
description: Added Supabase authentication and database. Opened for public access.

title: Theme System
description: Added Light and Dark mode support.

title: Model Updates
description: Updated system prompts and added Mistral AI support.

title: New Tools
description: Launched Landing Page Generator and expanded tool suite.

title: UI Updates
description: Updated UI with new components and improved layout.
